title: Assemble a closure scalar frame without transporting arrows
statement: Let ell be prime, Y, ProjectiveLine Y and diagonalSurface Y Noetherian, and ell invertible on Y. Let E be one finite subextension and d a rational Diagram [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category] with its prescribed spRationalTwist. There exists a ScalarFrame [lem-diagonal-uniformizer-scalar-frame] for the actual E-to-closure coefficient inclusion and closureLineMap [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-maps]: regular endpoints on every scheme, the two line endpoints, one supported endpoint, three normalized restriction/direct-image squares with mates invertible on the shifted root lines, and two normalized supported sources satisfying their scalar equations. The target models are scalarRightDerived. No diagonal class, trace, integration equation or finite-field transition is constructed by this statement.

source.place: paragraph (2), regular endpoints and closed-supported source assembly

proof.text: Pull invertibility of ell from Y to P and W. Apply the single-line closure comparison to q,p1,p2 using the three canonical functor equalities and full-unit equations recorded in d. Retain the line endpoints at P and W and the three normalized squares and mate-isomorphism proofs.

Use the regular-module flat scalar endpoint transported by normalized scalar multiplication at every scheme. Apply the existing supported-source scalar theorem to both projections, with the common regular endpoint. Their supported endpoint homs agree by adjunction injectivity and faithfulness of the underlying module map. Rewrite the second source equation using this equality and assemble all ScalarFrame fields.

theorem diagonalClosure_scalarFrame
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l)
    (d : Diagram (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} E.1) Y
      (fun X ↦ spRationalTwist X l E)) :
    Nonempty (ScalarFrame (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl l E) Y
      (fun X ↦ spRationalTwist X l E) (fun X ↦ spQbarTwist X l)
      (closureLineMap l E) d)
